findings.detail: Same problem as M2-S40-T1. A known cause is fixed by one validation check in one function, and the answer is direct execution because the change is simple and well-scoped. The earlier plan-mode step changes the scene but not the reasoning. Two wrong options also repeat earlier wrong options. Option A (stay in plan mode and design the change) matches M2-S40-T1's 'enter plan mode to explore and design first'. Option D (Explore subagent scans the whole repository) matches M2-S40-T1's Explore subagent option. At most one wrong option may repeat.

blind_answer.reason: Plan mode did the investigation and found a single, clear cause. The fix is one validation conditional in one function, so the scope is well understood. Switching to direct execution fits the pattern of planning to investigate, then executing directly. Designing alternatives, re-reviewing every billing file, or scanning the whole repo would be unnecessary overhead.
